attributes.name: link group markup
attributes.definition: How groups of navigation or footer links are structured in the DOM.

values.definition: Links are wrapped in unordered list items (ul/li).
Links are bare anchors or divs without list markup.

attributes.name: footer column heading level
attributes.definition: Whether footer column headings use a consistent heading level.

values.definition: All footer column headings use the same heading element level.
Headings vary in level or are not heading elements.
